question: What do we say when someone goes away on a trip? 👋
explanation: Awesome! We say goodbye and tell them to come back soon! 👋
hint: We wave our hands when we say this.

question: How do you feel when your friend goes far away? 😢
explanation: Great job! We feel sad because we will miss them. 😢
hint: It makes us want to cry.

question: How do you feel when Papa comes back home? 😄
explanation: Super! We feel very happy to see our family again! 😄
hint: You get a big smile on your face.

question: What do we wave when saying goodbye? 👋
explanation: Excellent! We wave our hand up and down to say goodbye! 👋
hint: It has five fingers.

question: What do we give Mama when she returns? 🤗
explanation: Wonderful! A big hug shows how much we love her! 🤗
hint: We wrap our arms around them.

question: What do we say to want them back quickly? 🏃‍♂️
explanation: Awesome! We tell them to come back soon because we love them. ❤️
hint: The name of our chapter!

question: Where do we pack our clothes for a trip? 🎒
explanation: Great job! We put our clothes safely in a travel bag! 🎒
hint: It has zips and we carry it.

question: Which vehicle runs fast on long tracks? 🚂
explanation: Super! A train goes chug-chug on railway tracks! 🚂
hint: It makes a choo-choo sound.

question: Which vehicle flies high in the sky? ✈️
explanation: Brilliant! An airplane flies up in the clouds! ✈️
hint: It has wings like a bird.

question: Which vehicle moves slowly on water? ⛵
explanation: Fantastic! A boat floats and moves on river water. ⛵
hint: We use oars to row it.

question: What do you see on your face when you are happy? 😊
explanation: Lovely! A big smile shows you are very happy! 😊
hint: Your lips go up!

question: What do travelers sometimes bring for us? 🎁
explanation: Awesome! They bring nice gifts and toys for us! 🎁
hint: It is wrapped in colorful paper.

question: Where do we go to catch a train? 🚉
explanation: Great job! Trains wait for us at the railway station. 🚉
hint: There are many tracks here.

question: Where do we go to catch an airplane? 🛫
explanation: Super! Airplanes take off from the airport! 🛫
hint: It is a very big place with runways.

question: What do we do to show love to our parents? 😘
explanation: Perfect! A sweet kiss shows we love them very much! 😘
hint: We do this with our lips.

question: What do we carry to drink on a journey? 💧
explanation: Awesome! We drink water from a bottle when thirsty! 🍼
hint: It is filled with cool water.

question: What do we look out of during a bus ride? 🪟
explanation: Great job! We see beautiful trees from the window! 🪟
hint: It is made of glass.

question: Who do we miss when they go far away? 👨‍👩‍👧
explanation: Super! We miss our loving family members when they travel. 👨‍👩‍👧
hint: Mama, Papa, and Grandparents.

question: What do we eat when we feel hungry on a trip? 🥪
explanation: Excellent! We eat tasty snacks like sandwiches and chips! 🥪
hint: It is yummy food.

question: What sound does a train make? 🚂
explanation: Wonderful! The train goes Choo Choo on the tracks! 🚂
hint: It rhymes with zoo zoo.

question: What sound does a car horn make? 🚗
explanation: Brilliant! We press the horn and it goes Beep Beep! 🚗
hint: It tells people to move safely.

question: Who drives a train? 👨‍✈️
explanation: Awesome! The train driver safely takes us to our stop. 👨‍✈️
hint: He sits in the front engine.

question: Who flies an airplane? 🧑‍✈️
explanation: Great job! The pilot flies the plane high up in the sky. 🧑‍✈️
hint: They wear a smart uniform.

question: What do we use to take photos on a trip? 📸
explanation: Super! We click happy pictures with a camera! 📸
hint: It goes click-click!

question: What does a traveler carry all their things in? 🧳
explanation: Fantastic! A suitcase is a big strong bag for traveling. 🧳
hint: It has tiny wheels and a handle.

question: What do we open to welcome someone inside? 🚪
explanation: Lovely! We open the main door to let our family inside! 🚪
hint: You knock on it before entering.

question: What do we make to celebrate someone coming back? 🍲
explanation: Awesome! We cook their favorite tasty food to welcome them! 🍲
hint: We eat it at the dining table.

question: What comes from our eyes when we cry? 💧
explanation: Great job! Tears roll down when we are sad. 💧
hint: They are salty drops of water.

question: What do we wear on our feet for a long journey? 👟
explanation: Super! Shoes keep our feet safe and clean when we travel. 👟
hint: We tie their laces.

question: What shines bright in the sky when we travel in the day? ☀️
explanation: Excellent! The yellow sun gives us light during the day. ☀️
hint: It is very hot and bright.

question: What twinkles in the dark sky when we travel at night? ✨
explanation: Wonderful! The tiny stars look so pretty at night! ✨
hint: They rhyme with cars.

question: Where do we sit inside a moving car? 💺
explanation: Brilliant! We sit comfortably on the soft car seat. 💺
hint: We put a seatbelt over it.

question: What do we wear to cover our heads in the sun? 🧢
explanation: Awesome! A hat protects our head from the hot sun. 🧢
hint: You put it on top of your head.

question: What do we call a short trip with family to a park? 🧺
explanation: Great job! A picnic is a fun trip with food and games! 🧺
hint: We take a basket of snacks.

question: What tells us where to go when we are lost? 🗺️
explanation: Super! A map shows us the right way to travel! 🗺️
hint: It has lines and pictures of roads.

question: What is the opposite of 'Go'? 🚶
explanation: Perfect! When someone goes away, we wait for them to come back! 🙋‍♂️
hint: Starts with the letter C.

question: What is the opposite of 'Sad'? 😢
explanation: Awesome! We are sad when they leave, but happy when they return! 😊
hint: You smile when you feel this way.

question: What color is the sky when we fly in an airplane? 🟦
explanation: Great job! The beautiful sky is blue! 🟦
hint: It is the same color as the ocean.

question: What do we read to pass time on a train? 📚
explanation: Super! Reading a story book is fun on a journey. 📚
hint: It has pages and pictures.

question: What vehicle do children use to go to school? 🚌
explanation: Excellent! The yellow school bus takes us to school safely! 🚌
hint: It has big wheels and many seats.

question: Who waits for you at home when you return from school? 👵👴
explanation: Wonderful! Grandma and Grandpa are always happy to see you! 👵👴
hint: Your mother's or father's parents.

question: What word means the same as 'return'? 🔙
explanation: Brilliant! To return means to come back home. 🔙
hint: It is the title of the chapter!

question: What do we use to clean our hands before eating on a trip? 🧼
explanation: Awesome! Soap washes away all the dirt and germs. 🧼
hint: It makes bubbles with water.

question: What covers us to keep us warm if we sleep on a train? 🛌
explanation: Great job! A cozy blanket keeps us warm when it is cold! 🛌
hint: You use it on your bed too.

question: What do we say to a friend who is leaving? 👋
explanation: Super! We wave and say Bye Bye with a smile. 👋
hint: We do this at the end of the day.

question: Which is a vehicle with two wheels and a bell? 🚲
explanation: Fantastic! We pedal a bicycle and ring its ting-ting bell! 🚲
hint: It has pedals.

question: What do we buy to welcome someone nicely? 💐
explanation: Lovely! Beautiful and sweet-smelling flowers make everyone happy! 💐
hint: Roses and lilies.

question: What is the opposite of 'Near'? 📍
explanation: Awesome! When someone travels a long way, they go far! 🔭
hint: Rhymes with car.

question: What do we pack to play with on a trip? 🧸
explanation: Great job! We take our favorite toys so we don't get bored! 🧸
hint: Teddy bears and blocks.

question: How do we wait for our family to come back? 🥰
explanation: Super! We love them and wait eagerly for them to come back soon! 🥰
hint: It makes our heart happy.
